nodes.name: Winter snowpack
nodes.desc: Crater Lake gets several metres of snow a year and it lingers for about eight months. It waters the slopes as it melts and feeds the lake.

nodes.name: Crater Lake water
nodes.desc: A very deep caldera lake with no streams flowing in or out; its water comes from rain and snow falling directly on it.

nodes.name: Volcanic ash soil
nodes.desc: Ash and pumice from the eruption of Mount Mazama left sandy, fast-draining soils that hold little water.

nodes.name: Fungi & bacteria
nodes.desc: Break down fallen needles, dead wood and carcasses on the forest floor and in the lake, returning nutrients to the soil.

nodes.name: Whitebark pine
nodes.desc: A high-elevation pine whose large seeds feed nutcrackers, squirrels and bears. Blister rust and pine beetles threaten it.

nodes.name: Mountain hemlock
nodes.desc: A conifer of deep-snow subalpine forest and one of the most recorded trees around the rim.

nodes.name: Red fir
nodes.desc: A tall fir of the snowy Cascade slopes, and a common conifer in the park forests.

nodes.name: Fireweed
nodes.desc: A tall pink wildflower of open and disturbed ground that deer and pikas eat.

nodes.name: Lake plankton
nodes.desc: Tiny floating algae in the lake that capture sunlight and start the lake food chain.

nodes.name: Mule deer
nodes.desc: The most recorded large herbivore here. It browses shrubs and wildflowers such as fireweed, and is prey for bears.

nodes.name: Yellow-bellied marmot
nodes.desc: A burrowing rodent of rocky meadows that eats green plants and hibernates through the long snow season.

nodes.name: American pika
nodes.desc: A small herbivore of rock slopes that eats grasses and wildflowers and stores hay for winter. Hawks and eagles prey on it.

nodes.name: Douglas squirrel
nodes.desc: Stores conifer cones in middens; bears raid these for whitebark pine seeds.

nodes.name: Clark's nutcracker
nodes.desc: The most recorded bird here. It caches whitebark pine seeds and forgets enough of them to plant new trees.

nodes.name: Deer mouse
nodes.desc: A small seed and insect eater that is prey for martens, hawks, snakes and many others.

nodes.name: Sockeye salmon
nodes.desc: A landlocked sockeye that eats plankton. Fish were introduced to the lake, which likely had no native fish.

nodes.name: Pacific marten
nodes.desc: A forest predator that favours deep-snow country and hunts rodents and birds.

nodes.name: Common raven
nodes.desc: An omnivore that scavenges carrion and hunts small prey around the park.

nodes.name: Turkey vulture
nodes.desc: A summer scavenger that feeds mostly on carrion such as dead deer.

nodes.name: American black bear
nodes.desc: An omnivore that eats whitebark pine seeds raided from squirrel middens, as well as deer and carrion.

nodes.name: Red-tailed hawk
nodes.desc: A soaring raptor that hunts marmots, pikas, mice and birds over open slopes and meadows.
